name: Aim Magnitude
summary: A Smart Action that moves the reticle at a set speed, in degrees per second. Used with Aim Angle, for example for recoil control.

where.text: Edit your Config (pencil icon) and open a binding, or add one with the + button at the end of the bindings list. Select the Smart Actions Editor button at the bottom, then add Aim Magnitude from the Aim Control category.

citations.quote: To edit the current Config, press the pencil icon.
To change a binding, just click on it.
To add a binding, press the '+' button at the end of the bindings list.
Select the Smart Actions Editor button at the bottom
Available actions you can use in your sequence.
Smart Actions come in categories of functionality.
Actions used to augment reticle velocity that seamlessly combines with the gamer's aim.

definition.text: Moves the reticle at a set speed and blends with your own aim. Used for things like recoil control or auto-turn, together with Aim Angle.

citations.quote: Move reticle at specified speed. Seamlessly integrates with user aim. Use in scenarios such as recoil control or auto-turn. (Use with Aim Angle.)

definition.caveat: In Destiny 2, Bungie's account policy says using keyboard/mouse adapters to "reduce recoil" "would be a violation", which can lead to escalating actions, including bans. See the Destiny 2 note on Bungie's policy.

plainWords.text: Its speed is set in degrees per second (°/s).

citations.quote: Aim Magnitude Smart Action is set in degrees-per-second (°/s)

plainWords.text: For the reticle, use Aim Magnitude rather than Right Stick Magnitude, which doesn't blend with aim.

citations.quote: This action does not integrate with aim. Use Aim Magnitude for reticle modification.

guidance.text: For recoil control, set its value to match your weapon. XIM's basic recoil control doesn't try to match the recoil pattern exactly.

citations.quote: Customize your aim magnitude action value to best match your weapon.
This is basic recoil control and isn't intended to match the recoil pattern exactly. For a complete solution, see Recoil Modeling.

guidance.caveat: In Destiny 2, Bungie's account policy says using keyboard/mouse adapters to "reduce recoil" "would be a violation", which can lead to escalating actions, including bans. See the Destiny 2 note on Bungie's policy.

confusions.name: Magnitude Quantization
confusions.note: Snaps your reticle speed to set steps. An aim setting, not an action.

confusions.name: Aim Magnitude Variance
confusions.note: Offsets this action's speed slightly above or below the value you set.

statement.text: A Smart Action that sets the right stick's deflection directly, for example for radial menus. It doesn't blend with your aim.

citations.quote: Set right thumbstick deflection at specified value. Use in scenarios such as automatic radial menu selection. (Use with Right Stick Angle.)
This action does not integrate with aim. Use Aim Magnitude for reticle modification.
